ai_summary: ## Executive Summary: Q1 FY27 Performance - BSE Limited  BSE Limited reported robust financial performance for Q1 FY27, showcasing significant year-over-year growth of 63% in total revenue and 62% in net profit, primarily fueled by an 80% surge in transaction charges and a substantial increase in investment income. This led to a strong quarterly EPS of Rs. 21.22, with overall operational and profitability metrics indicating healthy growth and no material red flags despite minor declines in treasury income and listing services.
